name: Give Ground (Combat)
body:
You let your opponents pull off their combat maneuvers against you in order to trick them into thinking you have let down your defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, 6th-level duelist

Benefit: You can choose to allow your opponents to automatically succeed with the combat maneuvers they make against you. When you do, you gain a +1 bonus per three levels of duelist you possess on all parry and riposte attack rolls made against that opponent until the end of the opponent’s next turn.
